verdict.label: Partner-only or paid / gated
verdict.summary: Spotify requires bringing your own OAuth app; Development Mode is capped at 5 allowlisted users, and Extended Quota Mode requires an established business with at least 250k MAUs.
verdict.cost: Free (App owner must maintain an active Spotify Premium subscription)

composioFit.summary: Composio does not offer a managed OAuth app for Spotify. You must create and configure your own custom OAuth app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
whyOwnApp: Composio catalog requires bringing your own OAuth app for Spotify
Dedicated API quota and rate limits scoped exclusively to your app
Custom branding and scope authorization for your specific agent features

phases.name: Create Spotify OAuth App
steps: Ensure your Spotify account has an active Premium subscription
Log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard
Enter App Name, App Description, and check Developer Terms of Service
Click CREATE to generate your Client ID and Client Secret
phases.handoff: Obtained Client ID and Client Secret from Settings.

phases.name: Configure Redirect URI and Scopes
steps: Copy the Composio callback redirect URL from your auth config setup
In Spotify Developer Dashboard, open App Settings -> Redirect URIs
Add the HTTPS redirect URI (note: localhost is disallowed)
Save settings and enter Client ID & Secret in Composio
phases.handoff: Redirect URI allowlisted and credentials saved in Composio.

phases.name: Development Mode Testing
steps: Go to App Settings -> Users Management tab
Add up to 5 Spotify account emails to the allowlist
Initiate test connection via Composio and verify initial token generation
phases.handoff: Test users allowlisted and successfully authenticating.

phases.name: Submit Quota Extension Request (Optional)
steps: Verify your organization meets requirements: established entity, company email, launched service with 250k MAUs
Open App Settings -> Quota extension Request tab
Complete the 4-step questionnaire detailing your application and submit
phases.handoff: Application submitted, status shows 'Sent' in blue.

phases.name: Spotify App Quota Review
steps: Spotify app review team evaluates application for policy compliance and tests app
Review feedback sent to developer email
phases.handoff: Spotify approves application and transitions app to Extended Quota Mode.

artefacts.title: Spotify App Settings Checklist
artefacts.body:
App Name: <Your AI Agent Name>
App Description: AI Assistant enabling users to interact with their Spotify playback and playlists.
Redirect URIs: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>
Note: Ensure redirect URI uses HTTPS (or explicit 127.0.0.1 IP literal). localhost is not permitted.

artefacts.title: Requested Scopes Justification
artefacts.body:
user-read-private: Required to verify user profile subscription type.
user-read-playback-state: Required to check current player state and active Spotify Connect devices.
user-modify-playback-state: Required to execute play, pause, skip, and volume adjustment tool actions on behalf of the user.
playlist-read-private & playlist-modify-private: Required to view and manage user playlists.

artefacts.title: Developer Policy & Privacy Checklist
artefacts.body:
1. Provide a public privacy policy describing user data processing.
2. Provide an accessible mechanism for users to disconnect their Spotify account.
3. Ensure data is deleted immediately upon user disconnection.
4. Do NOT use Spotify data/content to train AI or machine learning models.
5. Do NOT build voice assistant / voice control functionality into the app.

Control playback, set volume, skip tracks, and queue items on Spotify devices

redirectRules.rule: Must use HTTPS protocol unless using a loopback IP literal (where HTTP is allowed).
The host string 'localhost' is strictly forbidden; use explicit IP literals like 127.0.0.1 or [::1].
Loopback IP literals can omit the port in dashboard registration to support dynamic port assignment during authorization.

blockers.cause: The user attempting OAuth authentication is not added to the app allowlist while in Development Mode.
blockers.fix: Add the user's Spotify account email in Developer Dashboard -> App Settings -> Users Management.
blockers.fallback: Submit for Extended Quota Mode if operating as an eligible business with 250k MAUs.

blockers.symptom: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with body {"error": {"status": 429, "message": "Too many requests", "reason": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED"}}
blockers.cause: Exceeded development mode API request quota buckets.
blockers.fix: Reduce request frequency, follow Retry-After headers, and batch/optimize endpoints.
blockers.fallback: Apply for Extended Quota Mode via Dashboard questionnaire.

blockers.symptom: HTTP 400 Bad Request or invalid redirect URI validation error during app configuration
blockers.cause: Attempting to register a redirect URI containing 'localhost'.
blockers.fix: Replace 'localhost' with explicit IPv4 address '127.0.0.1' or use a public HTTPS domain.

blockers.symptom: API calls fail for all dev mode users unexpectedly
blockers.cause: The app owner's Spotify Premium subscription has lapsed.
blockers.fix: Renew the app owner's Spotify Premium subscription.

checklist.text: Verify app owner account has an active Spotify Premium subscription
Create OAuth app in Spotify Developer Dashboard
Copy Client ID and Client Secret from App Settings
Configure HTTPS redirect URI in Spotify dashboard (replace localhost with 127.0.0.1 if testing locally)
Create Spotify Custom Auth Config in Composio using Client ID and Secret
Add up to 5 test user Spotify email addresses under Users Management tab in Spotify Dashboard
Test connecting an allowlisted account via Composio auth session
Audit application to ensure no AI/ML training is performed on Spotify content and no voice-control features exist

uncertainties: Whether Spotify provides any alternative review pathway for non-profit or developer tools with under 250k MAUs.

claims.text: Dynamic ports for loopback IP literals can be used by registering the redirect URI without a port number.
claims.quote: If you don't know the port number in advance, register your redirect URI with a loopback IP literal, but without any port number.
